items.text: April A. Verlato is an attorney. She was elected to the Arcadia City Council in 2016 and has served as mayor. She runs a law practice focusing on personal injury, estate planning, probate, and trust litigation. She has served as vice president of the executive board of the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.

sentences.text: April A. Verlato is an attorney.
She was elected to the Arcadia City Council in 2016 and has served as mayor.
She runs a law practice focusing on personal injury, estate planning, probate, and trust litigation.
She has served as vice president of the executive board of the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.

items.text: Her campaign priorities include creating jobs, supporting small businesses, ensuring affordable housing, and addressing homelessness, with an emphasis on public safety and fiscal responsibility.

sentences.text: Her campaign priorities include creating jobs, supporting small businesses, ensuring affordable housing, and addressing homelessness, with an emphasis on public safety and fiscal responsibility.

items.text: As mayor, she oversaw a $9 million budget surplus and worked to reduce the city’s unfunded pension liability, according to her campaign. On the city council, she helped establish new design review rules, a floor area ratio limit, and a historic preservation ordinance, and obtained $167,000 from Los Angeles County for homeless housing, according to a past campaign website.
